purpose: Machine-readable DATA-FREEZE review requirements. Values marked engineering_default are implementation choices made before source reconstruction and scoring.

semantic_storage.initial_capacity_cycle_ids: dataset_manifest.reference_cells and independently recomputed original cycles1..10

early_viq_qv_64.npz.missing_representation: NaN values plus explicit false masks. An array index never substitutes for an unverified physical cycle.

semantic_storage.continuation_aliases_and_duplicate_ident: instrument_identity_bindings.json and independently validated native mapping

identity.continuation_axis: Retain source-authored segment-local summary sequence separately. Original instrument Cycle_Index and continuation offsets require original-log or independently authenticated record mapping evidence.

instrument_axis_evidence.source_selection: unique(Cycle_Index), delete first and last, then select instrument j per exported record k
instrument_axis_evidence.missing_evidence: Original instrument logs or independently source-authenticated per-record Cycle_Index mapping, including omitted cycles and continuation boundaries
instrument_axis_evidence.source_negative_time_repair: Author cell_analysis.m lines95-98 adjust the suffix of any negative ending relative-time record

native_instrument_recovery.complete_cohort_and_continuation_QA: 174 sources and all5 continuation joins independently audited, final artifact-wide DATA-FREEZE verification pending
native_instrument_recovery.within_file_restart: b1c18 only, run1 is independently source-audited nonaging characterization and has no main aging cycle ID
native_instrument_recovery.source_step_label_exceptions: 6780 electrically qualified main D records retain differing native Step labels, including386 early prefix rows. Literal step equality is an audit field. Control-system cause remains unverified.
native_instrument_recovery.unqualified_segment_handling: Retain affected original source, record-level failure/missing reasons and full qualification denominators. Only certified observations enter model inputs/targets.

reference.rule: pointwise median of all qualified original cycles in 1..10

orthogonality.reason: An unweighted OLS projection after IRLS on the same basis algebraically returns the OLS decomposition and removes robust coefficient resistance.

physics.local_energy_interpretation: Voltage integral of squared residual, Ah^2 V
physics.noise_interpretation: MAD of Q minus SG(5,2) per bin, a mixed measurement/interpolation/shape noise proxy

dynamics.slope_estimator: median of all pair slopes within last valid observations

machine_assertions.assertion: all four original archives fully downloaded, full SHA recorded and original HDF5 readable
all 169 fixed UIDs retained in qualification, continuations share UID, original instrument Cycle_Index certified by independently source-authenticated mapping rather than author summary 1:k

every valid capacity derives from a complete sign-consistent discharge phase, has certified counter origin and A/Ah units, and preserves time/integration support independently. A failed clock field alone does not invalidate device-counter Q(V). Original step-label exceptions remain explicit.
both nominal and early-initial SOH saved, main comparable definition registered before scoring
grid exactly linspace(2.8,3.3,64), no extrapolation, constant-current/contiguity/monotonicity checks use preregistered tolerances
absolute Q retains certified device discharge-counter origin and shape version has explicit 3.3V anchor
every input/reference/interpolated curve/denoised statistic is computed using original cycles<=100, with reference using only cycles<=10
mutating or truncating every suffix waveform, suffix temperature, suffix length and suffix target leaves early input/feature hashes unchanged
all population imputation/normalization/regularization statistics are fitted on each training fold only
all observed valid future SOH are target rows, absent future cycles retain mask/censor semantics, no future survival admission filter
all preset global/local/dynamic/residual features and same-shaped masks generated, reconstruction identity and weighted projection QA recorded
all temporal slopes and changes use actual original cycle distances, missing cycles retained and no consecutive renumbering
ICA/DVA and resistance/polarization stay masked unless the complete stipulated source certification exists
no physical cell, continuation or generated duplicate crosses train/validation/test within any fold
exact protocol stratification, fixed unseen-protocol sensitivity and all169 historical exposure published, singleton protocol variance claims absent
every required artifact, complete qualification denominator, field-level reason and global fingerprint exists
formal scoring starts only after complete DATA-FREEZE verification, every trained model references identical data fingerprint
formal model matrix contains exactly M0,M1,M2,M3,M3-NL,M3-NP,M3-NR with training_seed=42

reversible_engineering_choices.reference_and_robustness: Fixed in physics_features.DEFAULT_CONFIG and recorded above before real-source feature computation.
reversible_engineering_choices.representation: NPZ is permitted by contract, float64 feature arithmetic, boolean validity masks, NaN missing values.
reversible_engineering_choices.SOH_standard: Nominal 1.1Ah main denominator with separate early-initial capacity version, as registered in unified_matr_seed42.json.
reversible_engineering_choices.curve_thresholds: Current tolerance, minimum points, reversal tolerance, integration/summary tolerance and prefix support threshold are engineering choices recorded in unified_matr_seed42.json.
reversible_engineering_choices.split_details: 5 outer folds, training-only validation 20% and unseen-protocol sensitivity allocation are engineering choices, not contract-mandated sample counts.
reversible_engineering_choices.qualification: A cell failing a declared measurement check remains in the fixed169 qualification denominator with reasons and masks.
reversible_engineering_choices.post_freeze: Any material correction requires a new explicit version and retained history. Model performance never selects data edits.

review_scope.final_certification_rule: Only the actual artifact-wide verifier result plus successful normal training-loader probe can certify DATA-FREEZE. This checklist never supplies a substitute PASS.
